afterAuthorization.visibility: Public / Everyone on the intended Magnivis account
afterAuthorization.audio: Preserve original master audio; no added platform music or voice processing.
afterAuthorization.captions: Keep designed burned-in captions. Avoid visible duplication from native captions; retain accessibility options where they do not duplicate the designed layer.
afterAuthorization.comments: On, with normal moderation. First comments are optional and only after publication authorization.
afterAuthorization.reuse: Off initially for video remix, Duet, Stitch or equivalent reuse where offered; this is a recommendation, not an account setting already applied.
afterAuthorization.quality: Use the exact 1080x1920/30fps MP4. Enable HD/highest-quality upload if available; do not apply enhancement, reframing, filters, auto-edits or compression exports. Actual app controls are unknown.
afterAuthorization.syntheticDisclosure: Recommend enabling the available AI/synthetic-content disclosure for transparent synthetic narration. Confirm the platform's current prompt; no claim that all four have identical requirements.
afterAuthorization.commercialDisclosure: No paid promotion/branded-content tag if this remains an unsponsored Magnivis editorial post. Recheck if a commercial arrangement exists.
afterAuthorization.locationAndLinks: No location tag required; no invented destination account or tracking link.
afterAuthorization.crossPosting: Use each destination's package and copy independently; no automatic cross-posting or schedule is authorized.
afterAuthorization.youtubeAudience: Not made for kids: this is general-audience educational content, not specifically children's content. Owner confirms the actual audience setting.
afterAuthorization.instagramAccount: Use repository-confirmed @magnivis.media and the selected exact original cover; unmeasured grid risk accepted.
afterAuthorization.otherAccounts: Confirm actual Magnivis channel/account/Page; TikTok/Facebook identities and YouTube handle are not inferred.
